Hi, I'm no longer at Princeton, but I have no problems with you doing that, and can't imagine anyone one the current team would. 

I'm happy to release it to PyPI, and I'd be interested in helping contribute to the separate module - it does make more sense to have it in its own module. I mostly put them both here so I could compare the performance of the ML deduplicating and the GoldRush deduplicating. 

I haven't released to PyPI before, but I'll give it a shot, and will do my best to keep up with issues. 

(PUL team, let me know if you see any problems with any of this!)

Thanks @maxkadel! Should I adjust the copyright statement in the LICENSE file? I inferred who to mention based on github's contributor vivisualization, but maybe I reread that wrong.

https://gitlab.com/pymarc/goldrush/-/blob/main/LICENSE

Ah, yeah, that's probably because most of the commits were over a year ago, but if you look at the history they're all me, except for the last one.

It looks like I don't have permissions on the repo any more, but I'll reach out to the PUL folks on Slack and see how they'd like to handle it.
